name: Arul
reason: Genuine Tamil name aruḷ, grace; meaning correct.

name: Arulmozhi
reason: Real Tamil name (Arulmozhi Varman, Rajaraja Chola); aruḷ + moḻi correct.

name: Bharani
reason: Name of a nakshatra (technical term), usually given to girls; not a standard boy name.

name: Dinakaran
reason: Sanskrit dinakara, sun, Tamil -an ending; correct.

name: Elangovan
reason: Tamil iḷaṅkōvaṉ, young king/prince; established name.

name: Ilayaraja
reason: Tamil form is iḷaiyarāja (with ai); spelling/IAST corrected.

fix.meaning_en: Young king (Tamil iḷaiya, young + rāja, king).

name: Mahesan
reason: Devanagari used स instead of श for maheśan.

fix.meaning_en: Great lord; an epithet of Shiva (mahā + īśa).

name: Rangan
reason: Meaning "Stage" is weak; it is a short form of Ranganatha.

fix.meaning_en: Short form of Ranganatha, Vishnu of Srirangam (from raṅga, as in the temple name).

name: Ravichandran
reason: Sanskrit ravi (sun) + candra (moon); established Tamil name.

name: Surendran
reason: Sanskrit sura + indra, lord of the gods; established name.

name: Thiru
reason: Honorific word (Tamil "sacred", like Sri/Mr), not a personal name.
